correctness.rationale: Exact kernel disintegration produces an active signed-mass Bellman recursion; affine induction checks both child probabilities and both signs by endpoint convexity. Strict inequalities prove the unique rare-child path for strictly asymmetric splits and alternating ancestral signs. The homogeneous expression follows by summing a solvable recurrence. Direct exact-rational enumeration of the operator rows and signed choices passes 10,586 cases in 16 configurations plus 120 rational homogeneous identities. Finite enumeration is ancillary to the universal analytical proof.

value.rationale: The exact finite-horizon signed unconditionality problem is a natural endpoint benchmark for nonhomogeneous Haar filtrations. The two-scalar recurrence covers arbitrary sequences of level biases; strict rare-child and alternating-sign rigidity gives complete sharpness witnesses; homogeneous bias gives an explicit continuum of slopes and signed exponential corrections. The result is not merely the fair case in another normalization.
